description: Create a Helix workspace the user owns, when they want a new one rather than one helix_list_workspaces lists. It comes with the free Helix plan a new Foundry workspace gets.

client_token.description: A new UUID for each workspace, at most 64 characters. A retry with the same name and token returns the workspace the first call made instead of making another.

name: helix_create_workspace

created.description: False for a retry whose workspace the first call made.

title: Create a workspace
